// diagnostic

E0956

`{what}` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet

What

`{what}` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet

Why

The canonical TIR evaluator doesn't cover this construct yet

Fix

Report this unsupported construct as a compiler bug

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0956: tests/ui/template_loop_noncomptime_source.stderr.

Error [E0956]: An `@loop` source is not a compile-time list
  --> tests/ui/template_loop_noncomptime_source.jet:1:12
    |
  1 | @loop T in 1 {
    |            ^
 Why: `@loop` expands one item template for each value in its source list
 Fix: Use a reflected/comptime list such as `T.@fields`, or a closed type list like `[TypeA, TypeB]`
